g.text: SECTION N-S THROUGH H-101 / PIPE RACK / C-101 (AREA 100)

3. Nozzle elevations approximate (FEED) - from tray spacing 0.61 / 0.76 m per sizing.
4. Rack tiers TOS EL 106.0 / 108.5 / 111.0; air coolers on structure above tier 3.

6. Side strippers C-102/3/4 (east of plane, not shown) fed by gravity from C-101 draws.
